sloka: देशान्तरगता ये च द्विजा धर्मसमाहिताः ।आमन्त्रयस्व तान्सर्वानश्वमेधाय लक्ष्मण ।। ७.९१.१३ ॥
transliteration: deśāntaragatā ye ca dvijā dharmasamāhitāḥ ।āmantrayasva tānsarvānaśvamedhāya lakṣmaṇa ।। 7.91.13 ॥

translations.english: Lakshmana, invite all those Brahmins who are devoted to dharma and have gone to other countries for the Ashwamedha sacrifice.
